name: wsl-native-preview
description: Prepare workspace-bound WSL file links for the Codex Desktop built-in previewer with trusted lifecycle context.

interface.shortDescription: Preview WSL files in Codex Desktop without copying them.
interface.longDescription: Uses trusted SessionStart context, a workspace-scoped DOS device alias, and best-effort Stop correction to return the drive-path Markdown form verified to open Codex Desktop's built-in previewer.
defaultPrompt: Preview files from this WSL workspace.
Check this task's WSL preview context.
Release this task's WSL preview mapping.
